findings.highlight: cross him off our list of people to watch
findings.evidenceJa: 見て回るべき対象から外していい
findings.governingReading: 学校はいつも通り leads to 外していい and the explicit narration confirms his report is no Master at school.
findings.explanation: Dropping the school from surveillance becomes dropping Shinji from a list of people.

findings.highlight: She pounded me flat as soon as I let my guard down
findings.evidenceJa: 隙を見せたらバターにされる
findings.governingReading: 隙を見せたらバターにされる is the conditional fear explaining her present trembling.
findings.explanation: Fear of what Saber will do on a lapse becomes a completed beating when Taiga let her guard down.

findings.highlight: won't even have a corpse left to collect
findings.evidenceJa: 死して屍拾うものなし
findings.governingReading: 死して屍拾うものなし leaves a dead body with no collector, rather than annihilating it.
findings.explanation: Nobody collecting his corpse becomes no corpse remaining to collect.

findings.highlight: I hear Fuji-nee from behind me.
findings.evidenceJa: 背後の藤ねえに声をかける
findings.governingReading: 声をかける assigns the speech to Shirou, following his quoted excuse.
findings.explanation: Shirou addressing Taiga behind him becomes hearing Taiga behind him.

findings.highlight: a phone book being slammed on a table
findings.evidenceJa: 電話帳を重ねて台にするような物音
findings.governingReading: 電話帳を重ねて台にする describes the inferred noise of assembling a height aid behind him.
findings.explanation: Stacking phone books into a platform becomes slamming a phone book on a table.

findings.governingReading: 本気で落ちる follows an effective neck choke; he then separately protests transition into a throw and narrates fading consciousness.
findings.explanation: Passing out in the sleeper hold becomes falling physically.

findings.highlight: Bent nearly at a right angle
findings.evidenceJa: ほぼ直角に落とされながら
findings.governingReading: 直角に落とされ describes the throw’s downward angle, not a bend in his body.
findings.explanation: Being dropped nearly vertically becomes being bent into a right angle.

findings.highlight: It's probably because Shinji's never home.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜、最近調子悪そうだし。慎二は家を空けてばっかりだから
findings.governingReading: 調子悪そうだし followed by 慎二は家を空けてばっかりだから gives separate reasons to keep people around her.
findings.explanation: Sakura being unwell and Shinji being away become Shinji’s absence causing her illness.

findings.governingReading: それはこれから answers whether he has told her: that is still to come.
findings.explanation: Not yet having asked Sakura becomes an unfinished claim about what she is going to do.

findings.evidenceJa: 体調悪い子たちを家まで送って
findings.governingReading: 体調悪い子たちを家まで送って identifies illness and personal transport/escort, explaining the early club departure.
findings.explanation: Escorting unwell students home becomes sending the students home.
